description: This PHP source file defines the ParserFactory class responsible for creating and returning appropriate parser objects for different module views within the SuiteCRM application. It handles the instantiation of various parser classes based on view type, module, and package context, including overriding and custom parsing options.

classes.name: ParserFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating parser instances based on view type, module, package, and custom overrides.

methods.name: getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns a parser object tailored to the specified view, module, package, and optional subpanel name, handling different view types and overrides.

methods.name: checkForParserClass
methods.description: Checks for a specific parser class file based on view, module, and package, and returns an instance if found.

methods.name: checkForStudioParserOverride
methods.description: Checks for custom parser overrides defined in Studio module sources and returns an instance if available.
